verdict.rationale: Stagehand's own observability docs describe real-time visibility into sessions through the Browserbase session dashboard, including live screen recording and replay, which covers the watch-live half of the story. Nothing in the pack documents a human taking over control mid-run when the agent gets stuck, and the live view depends on the Browserbase runtime. Missing for 10: documented human takeover/interactive control of a running session, a handoff-back-to-agent flow, live viewing outside Browserbase, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
